title: Dripping tap washer
safetyNotes: Turn off the water supply under the sink before you start.
Close the plug so small parts cannot fall down the drain.
steps: 🚰 Turn off the water supply and open the tap to empty it.
🪛 Remove the tap cover with the screwdriver.
🔧 Unscrew the tap body with the wrench.
⭕ Replace the old washer at the bottom with a new one.
✅ Reassemble the tap and turn the water on slowly.

title: Loose chair leg
safetyNotes: Do not sit on the chair until the glue has fully dried.
steps: 🪑 Pull the loose leg out of the seat.
🧽 Wipe off old glue and dust from the joint.
🧴 Spread wood glue on the end of the leg.
🔨 Push the leg back in and tap it with the hammer.
🗜️ Clamp it and leave it to dry overnight.

title: Bicycle inner tube
safetyNotes: Park the bike on a flat, safe place away from traffic.
steps: 🚲 Remove the wheel from the bike.
🔧 Lever one side of the tyre off the rim.
🔍 Take out the old tube and check the tyre inside for sharp objects.
⭕ Fit the new tube with a little air in it.
💨 Put the tyre back, pump it up and refit the wheel.

title: Blocked sink
safetyNotes: Never mix drain cleaners. Wear rubber gloves.
If water comes up from other drains, call a professional.
steps: 🧤 Put on gloves and remove standing water with the bucket.
🧽 Block the overflow hole with a wet cloth.
🪠 Place the plunger over the drain.
⬆️ Push and pull firmly about ten times.
♨️ Run hot water to check that the sink drains.

title: Small hole in a wall
safetyNotes: Check for hidden cables and pipes before you work near sockets or switches.
steps: 🧹 Remove loose pieces around the hole.
🧱 Press filler into the hole with the putty knife.
⏳ Smooth the surface and let it dry.
🧽 Sand it until it is flat.
🎨 Paint over the repair.

title: Loose button
safetyNotes: Keep needles and scissors away from children.
steps: ✂️ Cut off the old thread.
🧵 Thread the needle and knot the end.
🪡 Sew through the holes four to six times.
🔄 Wind the thread under the button.
✅ Knot the thread and cut it.

title: Squeaky door hinge
safetyNotes: Hold the door while you work so it does not fall.
steps: 🚪 Open the door and find the hinge pin.
🔨 Tap the pin up with the screwdriver and hammer.
🧴 Wipe the pin and spray it with lubricant.
⬇️ Put the pin back in.
✅ Open and close the door to check the squeak is gone.

title: Loose cabinet handle
safetyNotes: Do not overtighten the screw, it can split the door.
steps: 🪛 Unscrew the handle from inside the door.
🔍 Check if the screw hole is worn out.
🧴 Put a little wood glue in a worn hole and let it dry.
🔩 Fit the handle with the screw.
✅ Tighten gently and test the handle.

title: Toilet keeps running
safetyNotes: Flush once to empty the tank before you work.
If water leaks onto the floor and you cannot stop it, close the valve behind the toilet.
steps: 🚽 Close the small valve behind the toilet and flush to empty the tank.
🔍 Lift the tank lid and find the rubber flapper at the bottom.
✋ Unhook the old flapper from its chain and pegs.
🔄 Clip the new flapper in and leave a little slack in the chain.
💧 Open the valve, let the tank fill and flush to test.

title: Weak shower flow
safetyNotes: Protect the chrome with a cloth so the wrench does not scratch it.
steps: 🚿 Unscrew the shower head by hand, or with the wrench over a cloth.
🍶 Soak it in vinegar for an hour to dissolve limescale.
🪡 Poke the holes with a pin and rinse with water.
🧵 Wrap thread tape around the pipe thread three times.
✅ Screw the head back on and run the water.

title: Slow drip at a pipe joint
safetyNotes: Close the valve first. If the pipe is cracked or water sprays, close the main valve and call a plumber.
steps: 🚰 Close the small valve on the pipe and place a bucket below.
🧽 Dry the joint with a cloth to see where the water comes from.
🔧 Tighten the nut a quarter turn with the wrench. Do not overtighten.
💧 Open the valve slowly and watch for drops for 5 minutes.
📞 If it still drips, call a plumber.

title: Blocked toilet
safetyNotes: Do not flush again if the bowl is full.
Never mix cleaning chemicals.
steps: 🧤 Put on gloves and lay towels on the floor.
🪠 Put the plunger in so it covers the hole completely.
⬆️ Push down gently, then pull up sharply ten times.
🚽 When the water goes down, flush once to test.
📞 If it stays blocked after three tries, call a plumber.

title: Slow shower drain
safetyNotes: Wear gloves. Do not pour chemical cleaners if you plan to use a snake.
steps: 🧤 Put on gloves.
🪛 Unscrew or lift the drain cover.
🪱 Push the drain snake in and twist to catch hair.
🗑️ Pull out the hair and throw it in the bin.
♨️ Rinse with hot water and refit the cover.

title: Mouldy bath sealant
safetyNotes: Open a window. Keep the knife blade away from your fingers.
Let it dry for 24 hours before using the shower.
steps: 🔪 Cut out the old sealant with the knife and pull it off.
🧽 Clean and dry the gap completely.
📏 Put masking tape on both sides of the gap.
🧴 Squeeze a thin line of silicone along the gap.
👆 Smooth it with a wet finger and peel off the tape.

title: Hang a picture
safetyNotes: Check for cables and pipes before you hammer near sockets or switches.
steps: 📏 Choose the height so the picture centre is at eye level.
✏️ Mark the spot lightly with a pencil.
🔨 Hammer the hook in at a slight angle.
🖼️ Hang the picture.
⚖️ Check it is straight with the spirit level.

title: Hang a shelf
safetyNotes: Scan the wall for cables and pipes first. If the detector beeps, choose another spot.
Wear safety glasses when drilling.
steps: 🔍 Scan the wall with the detector and choose a clear spot.
✏️ Mark the screw holes using the level.
🕳️ Drill the holes and push in the wall plugs.
🔩 Screw the brackets to the wall.
📚 Place the shelf and check it with the level.

title: Stiff door lock
safetyNotes: Do not use oil in a lock. It collects dust.
steps: 🔑 Check the key for dirt and wipe it.
💨 Blow graphite powder into the keyhole.
🔄 Put the key in and turn it a few times.
🧽 Wipe the key and the door.

title: Door does not latch
safetyNotes: Hold the door while you work so it does not fall.
steps: 🚪 Close the door and see where the latch hits the plate.
🪛 Check the hinge screws and tighten them.
🔩 If a screw hole is loose, use a longer screw.
📐 Loosen the strike plate and move it slightly to match the latch.
✅ Tighten it and test the door several times.

title: Hang a curtain rod
safetyNotes: Check for cables and pipes before drilling. Use a stable step ladder.
steps: 📏 Measure and mark the same height on both sides of the window.
⚖️ Check the marks with the level.
🕳️ Drill the holes and insert wall plugs.
🔩 Screw the brackets on.
🪟 Put the rod in and hang the curtains.

title: Cold draught at a window
safetyNotes: Do not seal air vents. Rooms need some fresh air.
steps: 📏 Measure around the window frame.
🧽 Clean and dry the frame.
✂️ Cut the strip to length.
🥶 Peel the backing and stick it along the frame edge.
🪟 Close the window and feel for air leaks.

title: Creaking floor
safetyNotes: Check for pipes and cables under the floor before screwing.
steps: 🔊 Walk on the floor and find the exact squeaky spot.
✨ Sprinkle talcum powder between the boards.
🔩 Screw down a loose board into the joist.
🧹 Sweep up the extra powder.
✅ Walk over it again to test.

title: Sticking drawer
safetyNotes: Wear a dust mask when sanding.
steps: 🗄️ Pull the drawer out fully.
👀 Look for shiny spots where it rubs.
🧽 Sand those spots lightly.
🕯️ Rub candle wax on the runners.
✅ Slide the drawer back and test.

title: Wobbly table
safetyNotes: Move heavy items off the table first.
steps: 🔍 Find the short leg by pressing the corners.
🔩 Tighten all the leg screws.
📎 Stick a felt pad under the short leg.
🪑 Test the table.
✅ Add a second pad if it still wobbles.

title: Scratch on wood
safetyNotes: Test on a hidden spot first.
steps: 🧽 Clean the scratch with a damp cloth and dry it.
🖍️ Choose a crayon or pen that matches the wood.
🪵 Fill the scratch and wipe off the extra.
✨ Polish with furniture wax.

title: Assemble flat-pack furniture
safetyNotes: Build on the floor with a blanket. Ask someone to help with tall pieces.
Fix tall furniture to the wall with the included strap.
steps: 📦 Lay out all parts and count them against the list.
📖 Read the instructions through once.
🔩 Build the frame first and keep screws loose.
🔨 Fix the back panel and doors.
✅ Tighten everything and fix it to the wall if it is tall.

title: Creaking bed
safetyNotes: Ask someone to help lift the mattress.
steps: 🛏️ Take off the mattress.
🔩 Tighten every bolt on the frame with the Allen key.
📎 Put felt pads where wooden slats touch the frame.
🛏️ Put the mattress back.
✅ Press on the bed and listen.

title: Trousers too long
safetyNotes: Keep pins and needles away from children.
steps: 👖 Try them on with your shoes and mark the length with a pin.
📏 Turn up the hem and measure the same on both legs.
✂️ Trim, leaving 3 cm for the fold.
📍 Fold twice and pin it.
🪡 Sew small stitches all around.

title: Stuck zip
safetyNotes: Do not force the zip. It can break.
steps: 🤐 Pull the zip gently to see where it catches.
🧵 Free any fabric that is stuck in the teeth.
🖍️ Rub a pencil or candle along the teeth.
🔄 Move the slider up and down to test.

title: Small hole in fabric
safetyNotes: Keep needles and scissors away from children.
steps: 🧶 Turn the clothing inside out.
✂️ Cut a patch bigger than the hole.
📍 Pin the patch behind the hole.
🪡 Sew all around the hole with small stitches.
✅ Knot the thread and trim it.

title: Ripped seam
safetyNotes: Keep needles and scissors away from children.
steps: 🪡 Thread the needle and knot the end.
📍 Start 2 cm before the tear.
🧵 Sew small straight stitches along the seam.
📍 Go 2 cm beyond the tear.
✂️ Knot the thread and cut it.

title: Bike chain fell off
safetyNotes: Wear gloves. Chains are oily and stain clothes.
steps: 🚲 Turn the bike upside down or lift the back wheel.
⛓️ Put the chain back on the small front gear.
🔄 Turn the pedal while placing it on the rear gear.
🧽 Wipe off oil with a cloth.
🛢️ Add a drop of chain lube.

title: Weak bike brakes
safetyNotes: Test brakes at low speed in a safe place before riding.
If brakes still feel weak, go to a bike shop.
steps: 👀 Squeeze the brake and look at how the pads touch the wheel.
🔩 Loosen the brake cable bolt with the Allen key.
✋ Pull the cable tighter with pliers.
🔩 Tighten the bolt again.
🛑 Test the brake while pushing the bike.

title: Bike saddle too low
safetyNotes: Make sure the saddle is above the minimum mark on the post.
steps: 📏 Sit on the bike and check that your leg is nearly straight at the bottom.
🔩 Loosen the saddle clamp with the Allen key.
⬆️ Raise the saddle a little.
⚖️ Align it with the frame.
✅ Tighten the clamp and test.

title: Bad smell from the sink
safetyNotes: Do not mix with bleach or drain cleaners.
steps: 👃 Remove food bits from the drain cover.
🥄 Pour half a cup of baking soda into the drain.
🍶 Add half a cup of vinegar and wait 15 minutes.
♨️ Flush with hot water.
✅ Run cold water and smell again.

title: Limescale in the kettle
safetyNotes: Unplug the kettle and let it cool first.
steps: 🔌 Unplug the kettle and let it cool.
🍶 Fill it half with vinegar, half with water.
⏳ Boil it, then leave it for 30 minutes.
🚰 Pour it out and rinse several times.
☕ Boil plain water once and throw it away.

title: Mould on a wall
safetyNotes: Open a window. Wear gloves and a mask.
Never mix cleaning products.
If mould covers a large area, ask your landlord or a professional.
steps: 🪟 Open the window and put on gloves and mask.
🧴 Spray mould remover on the area.
🪥 Wait 10 minutes and scrub with a brush.
🧽 Wipe with a damp cloth and dry.
💨 Keep the room ventilated so it does not return.
